findings.issue: D-2 (user-approved Q-2) says the rules compare the one-decimal rounded percentages, so an equity that rounds up to the required % must call. No test pins this down. Every call case (4/24, 0.1667, 0.5, 1, turn 0.25) is also >= the unrounded required equity, and every fold case is also below the rounded required %.
findings.evidence: Mutation in a scratch copy: replacing `equityPct >= requiredEquityPct` at src/advice/postflop.ts:96 with `result.hero.equity >= callAmount / (pot + callAmount)` (unrounded comparison) left all 12 tests in postflop.acceptance.test.ts and postflop.test.ts passing.
findings.fix: In describe('rule pot-odds-call'), add a flop case with equity 0.1665 (rounds to 16.7, below the unrounded 0.16667) and expect action 'call', equityPct 16.7, requiredEquityPct 16.7.

findings.issue: The toPct cases never use the `+ 1e-9` nudge. 0.1665 * 1000 is exactly 166.5 in binary floating point, so it rounds to 16.7 without the nudge. If someone removed the nudge, no test would fail.
findings.evidence: Mutation: removing `+ 1e-9` from toPct (src/advice/postflop.ts:41) left all tests passing. In Node, Math.round(0.5005 * 1000) is 500 but Math.round(0.5005 * 1000 + 1e-9) is 501. The same happens for 0.5015 to 0.5095.

findings.issue: The AC#3 property only ever reaches flop and turn decisions with 6 live players. Folds are excluded and stacks (160) exceed the maximum spend in a hand (96), so a hand can never end early and `fc.pre` (line 185) never discards a run. With stopAt <= 11 and at least 6 decisions per street, the river is never reached. The builder's random stop point is sound and is wider than the spec's 'first postflop decision', but the discard path is dead and 'any postflop decision' does not include the river.
findings.evidence: Instrumented run (seed 7303, 40 runs): 0 discards; 26 flop and 14 turn decisions, 0 river; every run had 6 live players; rules seen were check-free 31, pot-odds-call 8, pot-odds-fold 1.
findings.fix: Raise stopAt to fc.nat({ max: 23 }) so river decisions are reachable. Optionally allow folds by non-hero seats so opponent counts vary and fc.pre does real work. If neither is done, drop the claim in the comment or spec that runs are discarded.

summary: The implementation matches the spec. Pot is all pots plus every street contribution, the call amount comes from the legal call action, and required equity is toPct(call/(pot+call)), or 0 when nothing is owed. The rules compare the rounded values and a tie calls. Opponents are live non-hero seats with every unseen combo, ascending. Error messages match section 5 exactly, recommend() sends preflop views to recommendPreflop and everything else to recommendPostflop, and no engine, UI or e2e files changed. The rules doc is accurate, written for this project, uses the exact heading form, and the AC#5 test fails when the id sets diverge. All four spec mutation probes failed the suite as required: >= to > (AC#1 and pot-odds-call failed), dropping check-free (AC#3, AC#4 and others failed), a fourth rule id (AC#5 failed), and counting folded players (AC#1 and the inputs test failed). Extra probes on the pot formula, call amount, dead hero cards and hero cards passed to computeEquity were also caught. Two were not caught: comparing unrounded values (MAJOR test gap on D-2) and removing the toPct nudge (MINOR). The perf test at ADVICE_PERF_SCALE=1 gave p95 of 5.0, 13.0 and 71.5 ms against targets of 25, 50 and 100 ms. The grep check prints nothing. The scratch copy has been deleted.
